title: The Leatt Limited Nukeproof Axess Racing Capsule Collection
content:
Leatt is celebrating an exciting season with the Nukeproof Axess Racing (NAR) team by releasing a limited-edition capsule collection. As the 2026 World Cup enters its final phase, one thing is clear: nothing compares to the unbridled emotion of downhill racing. Leatt harnesses this energy with a radical creative direction that’s become the distinctive livery of the NAR team.

The team livery draws it’s inpsiration from the euphoric energy of 1990s rave culture and the excitement of the modern World Cup downhill circuit. “Downhill racing isn’t simply about performance,” says Mille Johnset, NAR’s standout Norwegian rider. “It’s the stoke, the chaos, the community. There’s so much passion for this sport everywhere we go. Wearing this gear is a signal to the world that we’re not afraid to have fun!

A small, limited collection of casual apparel is now available. Featuring all four NAR team designs, these t-shirts, long sleeves, hoody and cap are the same as those the team has been wearing in their downtime this season.

The limited capsule collection is available today at Leatt.
